thread:
sam (design): Quick thread: UX pass on inline autoscale row for compact dashboards. Focus: keyboard-first editing, clear billing language, and accessible guardrail affordance.
tess (product): thanks. product priorities: no surprise billing copy, obvious guardrail state, and small-screen ergonomics.
omar (eng): note: row lives in a virtualized list; avoid heavy rerenders on focus.
sam (design): proposal: view vs edit mode. Edit toggled by Enter or clicking pencil. In edit mode fields expand inline: Min, Max, SLO slider, Burst toggle.
mina (a11y): prefer inline expansion to help with context. Ensure focus moves to first field and Escape exits returning focus to the edit trigger.
sam (design): microcopy: burst badge -> "Burst: temporary capacity 1em14 additional charges possible" (trying to be direct but not scary).
tess (product): maybe shorten: "Burst: temporary capacity 1em14 additional charges possible" is fine.
omar (eng): inputs: allow arrows + text, clamp server-side and show inline error messages. We'll emit validation events.
mina (a11y): announce validation with aria-live=polite, and use icons + text for state. Do not rely on color alone.
sam (design): guardrail indicator: small label "Guardrail" + striped pattern when active. Tooltip: "Guardrail active 1em14 autoscaler prioritizes latency SLO; may use extra capacity."
tess (product): agree, and include CTA: "How burst affects billing" linking to docs. Add sr-only "opens in new tab".
mina (a11y): CTA must be focusable and have rel=noopener noreferrer when target=_blank. Tooltips dismissible with Esc and reachable by keyboard.
omar (eng): mobile: edit mode stacks fields full width. We'll call scrollIntoView on focus to avoid iOS jumps.
sam (design): hit areas: icons get 44px touch targets, visible icon size 18px. Ensure contrast passes AA at that visible size.
ci-bot: CI: ui/autoscale-inline-edit changes pushed to staging branch.
tess (product): please test staging keyboard flow and screen reader; post findings here.
sam (design): will update figma and checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
